Account summary: existing Redwood hosted_api customer since 2024; currently ~1.2M tokens/month (prod), heavy embedding usage for log search and triage. Primary drivers: predictable throughput for peak ingestion windows, EU data residency for GDPR, and lower per-token unit economics for high-volume reranking pipelines. Renewal + expansion ask: move core embedding/rerank traffic to Dedicated pool (reserved GPUs) + adopt Optimize product for batching/quantization recommendations. Customer quote: "We need predictable latency during incident spikes and an EU footprint — legal won't sign without residency guarantees." Commercial: willing to move to a 12–24 month committed contract if pricing + region SLAs align.
Key technical notes: SE validated that model variants (Llama-family quantized) meet quality bar for embeddings; caching reduces read ops for repeated log queries. POC findings: 22% cost down (batching/caching), 30ms median latency improvement on rerank flows. Outstanding items: final cost model for burst capacity, SOW language around data residency, KMS integration checklist, retention policies for embeddings (customer wants 1 year retention by default). Next milestone: submit final Dedicated sizing + draft SOW to customer (target: 2026-03-10), legal review to complete by 2026-04-01. Renewal date: 2026-06-30.
